timing.rule: First priced point vs first priced point at least 5 real minutes and 3 match minutes later; same match and confirmed final score.
timing.note: One pair per event; later point fixed by clock, never chosen by its result.

gate.rule: One first prospectively decidable exact-priced point per event; same Moscow day, exact score and total line; minute ±5; price ±0.05; distinct matched events without replacement.

first_quote_flow.note: A match may have multiple gaps; gap counts are not disjoint match counts.

first_decidable_flow.note: A match may have multiple gaps; gap counts are not disjoint match counts.

gate.decision_entry_rule: First prospective exact-priced strong or rejected point with sufficient sporting data; never backfill first quote or select by result.
gate.relaxed_rule: Separate diagnostic only: date ±7 days, exact score, total line ±0.5, minute ±10, price ±0.10; same league or country where specified.

**Срез: 29.10, 22:31 МСК.** Сравнение с 29.10, 19:04 МСК.

Всего наблюдалось 3 811 (+68) уникальных матчей, подтверждённо завершены 3 712 (+48), из них 3 563 (+48) с сохранённой ценой.
